note: M9 targets (ADR-045). Nothing here is authorised: each target needs an authorisation block, and the live-validation sign-off must approve this exact file before tools or people act on it. Expectations are control outcomes on the target; an empty set means observe only, never a pass.

targets.note: One GET with at most 3 redirects. Expectations are public knowledge (publicly trusted certificate, TLS 1.2 or newer, answers /); confirm before approving. Headers are observed, not expected.

Re-check https://nmap.org/book/legal-issues.html and the scanme terms (a few scans a day, no heavy scanning) before approving. The operator runs the command by hand and imports scanme.xml with vantage 'untrusted'.
Only against a Juice Shop instance you own and run yourself. Replace the selector with its URL and record the answer key (known issues) in expect before approving.
